title: Phase 6 / E09: Real PostgreSQL Concurrency & Contention Analysis Protocol
primary_question: Under high concurrent write contention on shared patient records in PostgreSQL 16.14, what is the throughput scaling curve, serialization conflict abort rate, and commit latency distribution across worker concurrency tiers (1, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64)?
unit_of_analysis: One multi-worker concurrent transaction batch executed against PostgreSQL 16.14.

primary_endpoints.name: Commit Throughput (TPS)
primary_endpoints.definition: Transactions committed per second across worker grid [1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64].

secondary_endpoints.name: Contention Abort Rate
secondary_endpoints.definition: Proportion of transactions aborted due to write lock contention under load.

sample_size.unit_definition: 504 benchmark runs across 10 workload families and multi-factor contention grids

statistical_plan.method: Multi-Worker Concurrency Grid Profiling & Latency Quantiles

stopping_rules.fail_closed_criteria: Any deadlocks or unhandled serialization failures halt the benchmark campaign.
stopping_rules.missing_data_rule: Failed worker threads are recorded as OPERATIONAL_FAILURE.
